services_heading: Complete Painting & Decorating Services Across Sheffield
services_subhead: From interior redecoration to exterior masonry work, we handle every job with care and attention to detail.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Refresh any room with expert preparation, premium paint application, and flawless finishes. We protect your furniture and keep disruption to a minimum.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Weatherproofing
services.desc: Protect and enhance your home's exterior with durable masonry paint and wood treatments. Includes power cleaning and surface preparation.

services.title: Wallpapering & Feature Walls
services.desc: Create impact with professionally hung wallpaper, from classic patterns to modern feature walls. We handle difficult corners and match patterns perfectly.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery Finishing
services.desc: Transform doors, skirting boards, and window frames with expert sanding, priming, and painting. Beautiful, durable results that last.

services.title: Landlord & Commercial Redecorating
services.desc: Quick turnarounds between tenants or a fresh look for your business. We work efficiently and guarantee professional presentation.

services.title: Specialist Finishes & Coatings
services.desc: Achieve stunning effects with colour-washing, stippling, and textured finishes. Bespoke solutions tailored to your taste and budget.

about_pullquote: We treat every home like it's our own. No shortcuts, no mess, no fuss.
about_para_1: ABS Decorator has been serving Sheffield for over 15 years, building a reputation for reliable, high-quality work across residential and commercial properties. We started because we saw too many decorators cut corners. From our base in Parson Cross, we've completed over 1,000 projects — everything from single-room makeovers to full house redecoration.
about_para_2: Our customers return because we listen, prepare properly, and finish to a standard we're proud of. We don't rush. Every job gets our full attention, whether it's a fresh coat of magnolia or a complete interior redesign. You'll find us clean, professional, and honest about timescales and costs.
reviews_heading: What Sheffield Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had the lounge and hallway redecorated. Extremely tidy worker, arrived on time, got the job done in two days and the finish is spot on. Couldn't fault him. Will definitely use again and would recommend to anyone.
reviews.author: David C.

reviews.text: ABS Decorator painted our kitchen cupboards and walls. What a transformation. Really professional, very clean, and he left the place spotless. Great communication throughout. Brilliant value for money. Highly recommended.
reviews.author: Margaret T.

reviews.text: Called for a free quote to redecorate two bedrooms. Very reasonable price, no pressure. Work started and finished exactly when promised. Attention to detail is excellent. The walls look fantastic. Will be calling him back for the rest of the house.
reviews.author: Steven H.
